title: Broncos LB Jonathon Cooper pleads not guilty to all charges, 1 day after placement on commissioner's exempt list for alleged domestic violence incident

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos LB Jonathon Cooper pleads not guilty to all charges, 1 day after placement on commissioner's exempt list for alleged domestic violence incident
sources.description: Cooper is now scheduled to face a trial by jury that will take place during Denver's bye week. He's been arrested twice over an alleged incident of domestic violence with his then-girlfriend.
